caseName: National Union Fire Insurance v. Camp
caseNameFull: NATIONAL UNION FIRE INSURANCE COMPANY OF PITTSBURGH, PENNSYLVANIA v. John B. CAMP, Trustee, Securities Investor Protection Corporation

opinions.text: The motion of American Insurance Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. The motion of Surety Association of America for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit denied.
